parsed.title: Malware Analysis - Remcos RAT - Part 1
parsed.summary: The report analyzes a Remcos RAT infection chain that begins with a spearphishing email containing links to a malicious RAR archive, which holds an obfuscated JavaScript file. The JavaScript carries a Base64 PowerShell payload that writes a script to the %TEMP% folder and establishes persistence through a startup shortcut and HKCU and HKLM Run registry keys. That script decrypts further layers using XOR and Base64 and ultimately launches binaries through aspnet_compiler.exe. The author notes the analysis will continue in a later part, which will examine the uncovered executables.
